observations: Photo 0 shows a used automotive transmission gearbox.
The unit is covered in a thick layer of grime and oil residue.
A black rubber hose is attached to the bottom.
The casing shows signs of wear and potential rust in the crevices.
No brand name, model number, or part number is legible on the casing.

claims.evidence: No Lexus logo, model badge, or part number is visible in photo 0.
The pin count cannot be determined from a single exterior photo.
No date codes or manufacturing stamps are visible.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Internal mechanical failure or seized gears
risks.proof: A video of the gearbox being manually rotated or a sound test of the input/output shafts.
A clear photo of the part number stamped on the gearbox casing.

risks.risk: Missing mounting brackets or internal components
risks.proof: A photo of the gearbox with all mounting points and internal components visible.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the part number stamped on the gearbox casing.
Video of the gearbox being turned by hand to check for smooth operation and internal noise.
Photo of the mounting brackets and the underside of the unit.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
